historical_claims.anchor: The Fellowship of the Ring and The Two Towers appeared in 1954, and The Return of the King in 1955.
The Tolkien Estate's account of the book's composition describes draft after draft
Carl Hostetter explains that Tolkien had been developing Elvish languages for decades
The critic John R. Holmes, in the 2022 Companion to J. R. R. Tolkien, identifies this intricate interlace structure
Literary scholar Vincent Ferré has argued that its landscapes, contemplations and apparent delays are central
Tolkien explicitly resisted the idea that the Ring must stand for one object in twentieth-century history
